goal: Add a shared logger utility to all packages in the monorepo

steps.name: create logger
steps.prompt: Create a typed Logger class in {{logger_file}} wrapping pino. Export a singleton logger instance as the default export.

steps.name: export logger from shared index
steps.prompt: Add an export for the logger from {{shared_index}} so consuming packages can import it.

steps.name: integrate logger into api
steps.prompt: In {{api_app}}, import the logger from {{shared_pkg}} and use it to log all incoming requests via middleware.

steps.name: integrate logger into web
steps.prompt: In {{web_main}}, import the logger from {{shared_pkg}} and use it to log unhandled errors via window.onerror.

steps.name: write logger tests
steps.prompt: Write unit tests for the Logger class in {{logger_test}}. Test that log methods emit the correct level and message.
